listings.rawTitle: Vanilla Shot Purse Spray Extrait de Parfum 15ml
listings.description: Essential and oriental, Vanilla Shot boasts a fresh and sensual richness that blossoms thanks to myrrh resin. The fragrance is energized by top notes of coriander, saffron and aldehydes and enhanced by the presence of rose and dried fruits.Perfumer: Bertrand DuchaufourInterested in the 100ml standard perfume? Click Here.*This product is being discontinued*

90th Anniversary Collection - Launched 2020When revisiting Prince Murat's original Chypre from 1930, Jean-Christophe Hérault plays with the enigmatic notes of a Lily, elegantly swaying between radiant florality and unsettling animality.Sustained by the refined aroma of LMR Patchouli Heart, this 21st century cyprus unveils a clean and ultra modern fresh floral character, emphasised by the scents of LMR Rose Oxide and Pink Pepper CO2 while revealing the bewitching sensuality of prominent old-world flowers through wild notes of Egyptian Jasmine in the Lily accord.

listings.rawTitle: Champs de Mai Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: 90th Anniversary Collection - Launched 2020To honour Prince Murat’s 1930 creation Champs de Mai, the perfumer Quentin Bisch naturally drew inspiration from the queen of flowers, the Rose, but for this modern interpretation he wanted to create a rose which radiates freshness.The Perfumer captured the scent of a rose at dawn in the Bagatelle Gardens during a beautiful month of May, when the dew vanishes under the sun’s first morning rays.Champs de Mail is a subtle and luscious rose smelled from afar. The bliss and caress of velvety freshness blooming with the new day.

90th Anniversary Collection - Launched 2020Reminiscent of the trees adorning the garden at the Galion’s private mansion, and the linden tree with its heart-shaped leaves – a symbol of Paris and freedom and love. Fascinated by this magnificent tree blooming in the streets of Paris in June, Quentin Bisch pays tribute with this new creation for Le Galion. A sensuous aroma, all-encompassing yet intangible. The scent of summer nights when the silvery lime trees with their honeyed scent blossom, arrestingly charming and sensual, diffuses their ethereal sillage through the streets of the most romantic City.A new composition revealing the sultry magic of this unusual accord, unveiled by notes of Ambroxan and subtle, luminous Musks.

Baptisma is a Perfume inspired by the baptismal water to encapsulate the scent of childhood.The very soothing scent of baby skin mixed with an infusion of verbena, ginger and bergamot – the result is an unusual composition of freshness, enveloped in carnal offerings of jasmine, ending in a scented ritual of innocent freshness.The milky white musk and incense reveals the purity of childhood nostalgia.

A perfume inspired by the Shaman's rituals who used incense sticks called Palo Santo when communicating with nature and burning the incense as an offering to the Gods. Palo Santo is considered as a sacred wood, whose translation is "holy stick". It is harvested from the soils of Latin America for its holistic benefits.The perfumer created Holy Stick as a smoky, woody and subtly spicy offering with the most soothing earthy and creamy dry down.

A raw and chic, refined and spicy fragrance.B683 is a result of the meeting of two young designers.One is a couturier, the other a perfumer, Quentin Bisch. Their childhood memories brought them together. Remembering captivating smells, of the leather from an elegant brief-case or distinct smells of burnt logs during the regular family gatherings to warm the family home.The artistic skills of the former and the olfactory talent of the latter together sparked a magical fragrance with notes of spices, leather and wood.Marc-Antoine Barrois called the Perfume B683, which is an imaginary planet as an invitation to discover his creative universe but also a nod to the book of Antoine de Saint-Exupéry "The Little Prince" whose planet is asteroid B612.The perfume exudes Marc-Antoine’s encounter of beautiful cuts, exceptional fabrics and subtle refinement of poetry and humanity. Subtly combining refined woody essences, sensual spicy notes and the powerful smell of leather, avant-garde perfumer Quentin Bisch is signing a perfume both heady and sober modelled on the fantasy universe of the designer.Looking for the 100ml Eau de Parfum? Click Here.Looking for the 50ml Extrait de Parfum? Click Here.

Ganymede is the new fantasy of Marc-Antoine Barrois. For this new opus, the destination is elsewhere. Creating an elegant and unexpected harmony around a quartet of mandarin, violet, immortelle and suede, the perfumer and the couturier have dreamt of this new planet: Ganymede. The rocky satellite of Jupiter discovered in 1610 by Galileo that is both luminous and covered with salt-water oceans. It acquired its name from the Greek mythology, meaning a young man, Ganymede, who was kidnapped by gods who had been so enthralled by his beauty that he was offered immortality.Created by perfumer Quentin Bisch, Ganymede makes use of the suede-leathery notes that had made B683 a beautiful classic. For Ganymede, the perfumer takes us towards a more luminous and fluid elegance. The leather notes are softer, lighter and gentler. The opening of Italian mandarin brings vivacity and evocative freshness, but also gentility with the contrasting and chic violet notes and Chinese osmanthus. The immortelle flower, yet opposing, raises the scented harmony with its double-sided notes of minerals and saltiness. The entire composition plays with contrasts and oppositions.Exquisite and timeless elegance, redolent of extraordinary luxury and pleasure.Looking for the 100ml standard perfume? Click Here.

New Parfum Strength The inspiration for this perfume is the queen of all tropical flowers "frangipani". The perfume is nothing like any tropical floral perfume we've come across, no sun umbrellas or sweet cocktails. This is green and bright, floral and creamy – a beautiful fragrance with resinous and woody undertones. The perfume composition opens with a sparkling squeeze of lime, before quickly calming into a wonderful linden blossom, whose aroma of honey and green powder forms a magical connection to the heart of the perfume - the frangipani. The frangipani note is so wonderful with rosy, peachy facets, and gives the heart of the perfume a gentle fruity dimension. Once settled, the frangipani melts into the magnolia, plum and orchid notes, and forms creamy and chocolatey feel A resinous, woody base keeps the creaminess of the florals in check, making sure that the perfume retains its exotic character, but never crosses the line into loudness. Frangipani is fresh and green, easy to wear, uplifting with light-hearted demeanour.

New Parfum StrengthOsmanthus is a fruity white flower from Japan and China.Like a bright and crisp spring day, this uplifting creation with Japanese Osmanthus absolute is a beautifully composed bouquet of jasmine and water lilies, embellished with golden citrus notes.Layered on a bed of Davana - a sweet Egyptian herb, where woody and musky notes give this wonderful perfume a solid structure. The overall feel is of a lively, intoxicating, crisp and clean floral, brimming with an abundance of citrus, that might make you yearn for it. It is intense yet fresh and uncomplicated.

listings.rawTitle: Madama Butterfly II Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A delicate green perfume cocooned in a floral yet musky explosion. The perfumer behind this creation is Euan McCall of Jeroboam Studio. Madama Butterfly II is a story of rebirth, a story which questions, challenges and redefines the traditional notions of femininity and independence.The perfume opens with green, fruity notes drenched in pink pepper.In the heart of the composition, the sakura, or cherry blossom, along with a crisp, green tulip note and iris, resonates the perfumer’s idea of scenting an entire avenue of sakura with raspberry scent.He’s created the most unusual opening, mingling the crisp vibe of quince with golden soaked marigold. Alongside the berry note the emotions are set to experience the seductive deeper, richer layers in the dry-down – tonka bean, seeping a moist gathered hay, velvet vanilla and chocolate-tinged patchouli. An operatic grandeur. Wearing Madama Butterfly II creates a sense of calmness.

listings.rawTitle: Migration de L'Arbre Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Distilled fifty shades of green. Inspired by Nankichi Niimi's 1930's short story "Last Year’s Tree"This perfume is a "window of enlightenment", a tale of friendship between a bird and a tree. The bird sings for the tree every day, until it has to migrate to the South to survive winter; it does so with a promise to return in spring and sing for the tree again. Upon its return, the bird finds only a stump in the place of its dear friend… The perfumer choses clary sage as a central theme to convey the perpetual motion of Nature. The various facets of this ingredient – herbaceous, floral, tobacco – are highlighted during the different stages of the fragrance’s evolution. The opening of Migration de L'Arbre is a wonderful citrus blast, creating a calm sensation of walking through a serene forest after the rain: an exhilarating feeling and the smell of damp grass and earth, just when the sun peeks through the ancient old trees. The floral facets of clary sage are highlighted with apricot-tinged osmanthus and touches of magnolia. The increasingly musky clary sage is mellowed by a warm sensation of light sweetness, as the synergy of coumarin - a hay like tobacco, pomegranate, unexpected fruity accents and aromatic mastic, create an unexpected turn of motions. The base of the Perfume revolves around patchouli and a plethora of wonderful woods, handled in the most ethereal way. The dry-down, a sort of "closed loop" aspect of the story, where one sensation or material evaporates, another similar takes its place, moving – or migrating – the perfumer created a textural accord to represent the bird without the use of animalic materials. By using seaweed absolute, cumin and a complex blend of grasses, herbs and molecules, the composition produces a sensation, which resembled the plumage of the bird, "soft, nuzzling, mineral-like." - Euan McCall.

Untamed heretical elegance, unleased in a raw yet graceful manner. "The tsar is dead, long live the tsarina!"Diplomat by day, conqueror by night, La Tsarine eau de parfum is based upon the life of Russian empress, Catherine the Great, but specifically her extravagant and mysterious life, and her apocryphal sexual appetites. This is a bold and uncompromising perfume. Sexual, animalic with immensely beautiful dry-down.There is no subtle playfulness to La Tsarine. The top notes reveal the viscous sweetness of honey, contrasted with cumin. The sticky greens of blackcurrant buds and clary sage add to the air of sensuousness. The Perfumer assembles three floral notes, which are known to spark the sense of arousal: the indolic trio of tuberose, narcissus and jasmine - an explosion of animalic floralcy.The dry down is a doubled up on animalics, where we encounter civet, costus, castoreum, oakmoss and musk. Taken all together, La Tsarine is unapologetically erotic.

listings.rawTitle: Duo Des Fleurs Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: 500+ real flowers duetting in a bottle. No less. "Under the dense canopy where the white jasmine blends with the red rose.Escape with me tonight, I hear Sarasvat calling us from afar!" A chaotic 'end of the 19th century' adventure: two lovers are escaping the British Raj. The Flower Duet, which was the genesis of the tragedy, becomes the source of felicity.Duo des Fleurs is interpreted into a sublime carnal opening of prominent Rose de Mai and indolic Jasmine, transitioning through the heart of the perfume with jammy rose otto, rose petals and more seductive jasmine divinities. The culmination of the dry down, the masculine sandalwood, seductive musk and mitti attar – this perfume is nothing but intoxicating lyricism.

Between sea breeze and rocky cliffs drenched with salty residue from the waves of the ocean, floats the free spirit of Alexis Zorba over the Cretan hills covered with wild plants and carob trees.The temper and radiance of this marine based perfume, beckons the insatiable thirst for adventure.This is a wonderfully aromatic and woody based perfume, drenched with marine notes, salty amber, sage, orris and oakmoss.

A perfume with a crisp and pure effect, radiating the light of the soul.The marriage of the notes resonates like a psalm to the splendour of King David.The composition opens with peppery notes to awaken the senses, following the softness of the jasmine and calmness of sandalwood for inner peace, and then gently taking the olfactory experience to a realm of emotions with the power of musk, amber and earthy patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Under The Figtree Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Sat under the cool canopy of the fig tree, where shade and respite from the heat of the Mediterranean sun is welcome.Inhale nature's gifts - the soft, green, milky delicately fresh scent of the perfume.Fresh but tender, green but not tart, all the facets of the fig tree are here - fruit, leaves and wood.Delicious, aromatic and sophisticated.

New Parfum StrengthA refined symphony of woods.A peppery, green, crispness in the opening notes, with an underscore of trees: cedar, agar and sandalwood hovering beneath.Imagine a crisp white shirt and a freshly laundered linen jacket, casual but assured, confident but approachable.This is the scent for a refined, but relaxed and contemporary gentleman.

New Parfum StrengthAn enigmatic perfume, where cool green herbaceous grass and coriander notes create contrast against the warmth of cardamom and violet.Black Hemlock with its slightly fruity accents deepens the play on juxtaposition, and vetiver with amber furthers the intrigue, creating depth and olfactory drama.Feminine, powdery, intimate and sensuous.The beguiling, bewitching aura of a Woman.

New Parfum StrengthChampaca is unusual in a sense that it is a floral fragrance that doesn’t smell of flowers, especially of champaca flower (Magnolia champaca or commonly known as champak, is a large evergreen tree in the family Magnoliaceae).The perfume is centered around green tea note with a zesty lemon. The peppery coolness of neroli, bamboo and green tea soothes senses and restores inner peace. There is a hint of freesia, which evokes fresh linen soaking up the sun; there is a great deal of yellow champaca blossom, but perceptible as a burst of something lemony and creamy, like magnolia with an undertone of honey. The flowers simply melt into the basmati rice accord to form a subtly peppery creaminess which releases the sharpness of the green tea and citruses. There is something wonderfully charming about the perfume Champaca. As sensual as clean skin, Champaca as a soft, slightly milky floral oriental that will enchant even the hottest of weather.

New Parfum StrengthImagine being sat in a peaceful glade in the middle of an ancient forest.The warmth of the morning sun starts to awaken nature’s olfactory alchemy. As the rays start to filter through the majestic canopy of trees, scents begin to emerge. Evernia is the latest creation from the House and, like everything in the Signature Collection, it is a luxurious perfume with incredible oakmoss absolute as a centrepiece.Evenia is Latin for oakmoss and grows on oak trees and conifers across the Northern Hemisphere. The fragrance is complex, green and woody, and the playful additions of lily, freesia, violet and orris, create an exquisite oakmoss heaven. The sandalwood adds a smooth finish with hints of spice and aromatic magic "…as the day comes to life, the astringent rich verdant scent of oakmoss begins to resonate and lets it's presence be known".

The trilogy in the Verci Studio by the House of Mendittorosa is now complete with the latest addition – Albatros. The Perfume is inspired by the poem of the same name by Charles Baudelaire (1821-1867). The poem was published in the collection Les Fleurs du mal. Albatros is a flight of sharp salted citrus, glides high above the earthy woody scent of dormant and active volcanos beneath. How far above the world the Albatros glides, free as a bird, swooping amongst the scent of ozone and salt air. Where gender has no name, where scent becomes one - earth, air, sky and sea, captured in a bottle. A carefree, happy scent for days spent outside, for the moment of now. Formula: Anne Sophie BaeghelStudio and project: Stefania Squeglia Stefania’s concept for this creation is a wind of Freedom, without fear, hesitation and shame. A cerulean horizon that welcomes those, who want to open their wings.*Perfume Notes*the "Modern Rose" accord is a composition of different natural and synthetic notes of rose elaborated by Anne Sophie Baheghel for Albatros.All the woods are naturals, except cashmere wood (Cashmeran molecule).

Hermit Coat Eau de Parfum is the perfumer’s nod to "Hermit", defined as someone who retires from society to live in solitude, often for religious reasons. Like a hermetic coat, this perfume by Chapel Factory is a veil of the past, nostalgic, reminiscent of old forgotten places, comforting and soothing with a tinge of melancholy. A captivating fragrance with herbal, green and golden, soft velvety notes. It evokes the colours of autumn, where nuances of pine, firs, creosote, soap and the furry warmth of animalic undertones give reassurance amongst the dark nights and colder days. Echoing its powerful vocation of roaming incense, aptly kept with the brand’s incense inspired collection – we invite you to wear Hermit Coat for a very eclectic look.

listings.rawTitle: Les Demoiselles de la Rue de Provence Perfumed Candle
listings.description: An intense tuberose flower whose aroma usually reveals its heady fragrance after dark, can now be enjoyed at home in Jovoy's "Les Demoiselles de la Rue de Provence" sensual candle. The fragrance is a tribute to the ladies of Paris who inflame the hearts under the French Cancan rhythm.

listings.rawTitle: Une Île Pluvieuse Extrait de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: “The sea is the place where a fisherman earns his living, a rippling field where, instead of waving heads of rice or wheat, the white and formless harvest of waves is forever swaying above the unrelieved blueness of a sensitive and shifting soil.”Inspired by Yukio Mishima’s 1950s novella The Sound of Waves (Shiosai), Une Île Pluvieuse conveys the mystique of a lovers’ tryst down a pathway drenched in rain, veiled in mist, scented by the sea spray, and bejewelled by the forest flora, on a faraway island in Japan.

In 2022, Maison MARC-ANTOINE BARROIS invites you to discover a new planet. ENCELADE is born from Marc-Antoine’s desire to write a new story about a sensual elegance full of wild imaginations and magnetic energy.A path into the jungle on the slope of a volcano, and after significant research, a new planet is born.Meet ENCELADE - another moon from the solar system, another mythologic reference.This fragrance is the reflection of an osmosis between strength and sensitivity. A soft mineral vetiver touch, enveloped in green leather and rhubarb. Take a break with this sweet poetry, named after the satellite of Saturn, Enceladus, covered with water and icy snow but that could be dreamed with volcanoes and a luxurious green jungle.With notes of rhubarb, vetiver, cedar, tonka and sandalwood - here we have a sensual, energetic and wild fragrance.Interested in the 30ml size? listings.rawTitle: La Dame Aux Camèlias Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Immortalised in literature, her dazzling fate leaves the memory of one of the most beautiful women to have ever graced the streets of Paris. Illuminated, revered and fetishised, her reputation and infamy undimmed over time.Notes of Bergamot, Grapefruit, Rose, Violet, Honey, Musk and Ambergris create a powerful sensual fusion of olfactive erotica.

The inspiration behind this sumptuous perfume is the destiny of an Englishwoman who arrived in Paris to accomplish an ambitious ascent. Cora Pearl bathed in the aristocracy and in her tub of champagne, as the whole of Paris recounted her escapades.Like Cora Pearl herself, this perfume is multi faceted, and also captures the allure of a warm blooded horsewoman who leaves a sillage (trail) of opulent spiced chypre notes in her path.Intoxicating, mesmeric and moreish - a perfume to heighten the sensuous and the animalic within us.Notes of Bergamot, Cardamom, Jasmine, Violet, Amber, Oakmoss and Vetiver collide in sensual abandonment.

listings.rawTitle: La Belle Otero 50ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Nothing could be more picaresque than the life of “La Belle Otero”, singing, dancing, contorting herself, jumping on a table, twirling her skirts. The beautiful gypsy has an insatiable nature. The queen of elegance frequented kings and rich bankers from Paris to New York, St. Petersburg and Monte Carlo. She was the most spellbinding and the most ruthless courtesan of the Belle Époque. She devoted her life to dancing, men, precious stones, gambling, parties and above all, freedom.La Belle Otero eau de parfum is an invitation to misbehave. Licentious Pepper, illicit Absinthe, covetous Violet and concupiscent Sandalwood. It's evolution leaves a certain delectation on the skin.

Harmony, precision, classicism, style and restraint are the values Cléo de Merode acquired at the Paris opera. But her controlled appearance conceals a more ambiguous nature. Like a fierce hetaira, she stands out in a sort of brothel that has become the foyer of the ballet school. She was considered the world’s most beautiful woman in 1896. An absolute star, she captured her contemporaries’ imagination.Melle Cléo eau de parfum is a sort of olfactory choreography with unpredictable variations. Botticellian Rosewood, night blooming Cereus worthy of Asparas and Cotton-flower for the most angelic Cocotte.

This nocturnal, vampire-like creature has burst upon the social scene, where she brings a fragrance of newness. She is perfectly beautiful with a boldness that makes her fashionable.La Castiglione has odd manners. She doesn’t make conversation, babble or dance, for she wants to be an almost silent divinity, like a statue, an effigy. A photographic word about the role she wanted to play, a faithful allegory of beauty, according to Baudelaire, is all that will remain.By candlelight, La Castiglione eau de parfum evokes a lusty, sooty commotion. Bewitching Patchouli, libidinous Copahu, elegant Cade and caressing Amber Gris. A fragrance with a dark vapour trail.

Far beneath Andalusian skies, the shade of hidden rooftop gardens beckons.The indolent scent of Neroli, Orange Blossom, Green Oranges and mint radiate, and carry on the afternoon whisper of a breeze.Like the spirit of a Sevillian poet, the ethereal perfume of nature, underpinned by a rustic green tea, dances silently in air. An invisible olfactory ballet for the senses.

1955, The calm before the storm.In the midst of the reconstruction period, Violet, like France, was seeking to repair its damaged heritage. Spreading a new message, that of a future sweetness, was its will.The house expressed itself thanks to Nuée Bleue, before falling asleep for over sixty years. A last breath rich in symbolism, Nuée Bleue becomes renewal.Translated as 'Blue Cloud' is a perfect expression on the skin of gentility and tenderness.Evocative of another era, where the simplicity of beautiful things made for a deep appreciation of uncomplex but truly exquisite perfumery.Bergamot, Lemon and Orange Blossom collide with powdery iris and softly spiced carnation. Underneath lies the plushness of sandalwood and white musk - an ode to twilight perhaps, or possibly daybreak - a perfumer’s palette suggesting the hushed impressionistic tones of baby blues, soft jades and pastel hues of very early morning.

1923, shades of a season.A poetic wind was blowing through the vigour of this bubbling period, humming enchanting and liberating lullabies. Violet, in the heart of his perfumery workshop, reached out and translated Pourpre d'Automne from the murmurs of his century.A perfume that is permeated by the lyricism of its time, its chypre ornaments and its figurative fruits. Pourpre d'Automne is none other than the perfume of poetic melancholy.Purple lipstick on soft skin. They depict a fragility imbued with recklessness. The touch of a delicate moment. A perfume interpreted as a "caress".Its autumnal chypre atmosphere takes its chalky powdered notes, exalting and uplifting the exquisite accents of juicy peach. Captivating, mesmerising and ethereal.Inspired by the version of 1923, Pourpre d'Automne was an iconic fragrance of the House. The bottle was imagined by Lucien Gaillard and was adorned with vine leaves.It garnered many awards, notably at the world exposition of 1925.

1900, a modern myth.Originally named Ambre Royal, this rich unapologetic composition beguiles and bewitches with its opulent brush strokes of Patchouli, Rose, Tuberose, Nutmeg, Amber and Madagascan Vanilla.This glowing burning sunset of a perfume, exudes an aura of amber and chypre facets that come alive on the skin as tenacious, ember like, sensuous, and inextricably French - this is subtly erotic, aplomb with nocturnal beauty, and the promise of deep dark night, where lovers lay in breathless and audacious silence.

1939, a solar bouquet.Located in the rue du faubourg saint honoré, the perfumery VIOLET created "COMPLIMENTS" perfume. 82 years later, its successor loses the 's' from the original name and to become COMPLIMENT: the one that really counts.An impossibly beautiful Tuberose that harks back to the glamour of the golden age of the Silver Screen: imagining Marlene Dietrich drenched in a veil of the most decadent white florals - Eucalyptus, Palmarosa, Jasmine, Tuberose, Orange Blossom and Benzoin.

listings.rawTitle: Un Air d'Apogée Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: 1932, a victory of contrasts. Caught in the exhilaration of the roaring late twenties and its quivering atmosphere, Violet portrayed this contrasting era in a scent accented by restless nights. Un Air d'Apogée is an invitation to enjoy the essentials of what life has to offer. A scent of audacity.It is reminiscent of a bygone era, a deeply nostalgic and vintage style perfume that transports us back in time, to an era of elegance, opulence, androgyny and liberation.Anise, Honey, Mimosa, Hay, Leather and Tobacco marry together in an unorthodox olfactory union of gentle, animalic sweetness. A complex composition with the distinctive aroma of hay, the warmth of Leather, and the dryness of Tobacco create a base of contrasts, that the erogenous notes of honey and mimosa sit upon. Exquisite, timeless and sensual elegance.

1922, a fragrance woven into the skin.Auspicious for sculptural art, this period has met many renowned artists such as René Lalique, Lucien Gaillard and Auguste Rodin. Closely linked to the history of the House, their friendship with Violet inspired the house to present a perfume visually illustrating the textured aesthetic of women. Tanagra is the wake of inspiring beauty. Inspired by the small statuettes of ancient Greece, the still, understated notes of freesia and iris hover delicately above an apricot tinged rose and a tender jasmine. The smooth whisps of soft musk and plush cedar underpin a contemporary interpretation of a classic floral: feminine, elegant and discreet. A florality that whispers, rather than shouts.

Cream Leather Case EditionFresh, feminine and intriguing floral.This is a fragrance created to celebrate all the joy of Collette's famous heroine "GIGI" - a beautiful, mischievous and intriguing character, who seduced with her simplicity and outspokenness.A fresh, lively and impossibly feminine fragrance full of fruit and white flowers.

Perfumer: Marie HugentoblerGourmand, Resinous"Cacao Porcelana is inspired by childhood memories with my grandparents. A true Proustian madeleine."An elegant and distinctive fragrance, centre stage for it has been chosen to be an unusual ingredient, the white cocoa. A rare variety, this white cocoa grows in the heart of the oldest plantations in Piura, northwest Peru. Extracted by hand from the pods, the beans are fermented before being sun-dried and roasted. To enable the Perfumer to capture the most beautiful facets of this white cocoa, she collaborated with a French Maître Chocolatier to obtain the perfect roasting, thus revealing sensual nutty and milky notes, with tonka bean undertone. After a sweet rum opening, the perfumer Marie Hugentobler unveils an addictive bitterness of the cocoa that is tamed by powdery and woody notes. A dry down of light tobacco, patchouli and sandalwood follows and giving Cacao Porcelana its sensual and unique signature.Nutty as much as it is chocolatey, this is suave and grown up – boozy rum and rich dark cocoa with a knowing hazelnut bitterness.An extremely beautiful night perfume for the daring and glamorous.

Perfumer: Celine PerdrielWoody, Leather, Animalic"Patchouli, a classic ingredient in perfumery, also known as Nilam in Indonesia, has shaken off its hippie image in this Haute Couture composition. Reinvented by perfumer Celine Perdriel, highlighting its dark and animalistic facets."Very enigmatic and complex perfume, warm and cool at the same time, herbal and fruity. Approachable, masculine but tender, a kaleidoscope of layers.The fragrance opens with sophisticated violet leaves, combined with leather and tobacco. In its heart, the nobility of rose meets the impertinence of leather. Finally, the patchouli's depth blends with intoxicating notes of tobacco, creating a sensual trail. A bold choice that underlines the profound nature of patchouli.

Aromatic – Spicy - Amber A sun-drenched reverie, where light lingers on skin and time slows beneath a Provençal sky. At its heart, helichrysum—immortelle—reveals itself in full bloom, captured through an innovative extraction that preserves its true essence: golden, aromatic, softly fruity, with whispers of spice and worn leather. Around it, a textured harmony unfolds. Hazelnut and candied fruits lend a gentle, almost nectar-like sweetness, while patchouli, styrax and warm woods ground the composition in resinous depth. Subtle touches of spice and a fleeting hint of liquorice create contrast—light against shadow, warmth against earth. Elegant yet vivid, the fragrance evokes the heat of southern stone under the midday sun, where florals glow with quiet intensity and every note feels bathed in golden light. Perfumer: Antoine Lie Composition: Grand Cru French Everlasting 'Full Spectrum' Ultrasound Extract 3.3% Aceh Indonesian Patchouli Oil 2.9% Grand Cru Italian Hazelnut Ultrasound Extract 1.9% Honduran Styrax Oil 0.5%

Orange blossom - Spicy Oranger Sirocco is imagined as a fragrant horizon—a point of light and warmth that draws you inward as much as it carries you away. Both radiant and meditative, it feels like a quiet return to something essential: joy, simplicity, and the poetry of the senses. From the very first breath, a warm wind rises—soft with sand and sunlight—guiding you across the Mediterranean to an orange blossom grove in full bloom. The air shimmers with their intoxicating sweetness, luminous and alive, while in the distance, the gentle rhythm of a souk unfolds. Spices drift through the air in slow, undulating waves, weaving through the steady pulse of the sirocco. It is a fragrance of movement and stillness, where light, scent and memory blur—an ode to warmth, to place, and to the quiet beauty of being carried elsewhere. Perfumer: Antoine Lie Composition: Oranger flower absolute Morocco 3% Petitgrain oil Morocco ‘Grand Cru’ 2.4% Royal Cinnamon oil Laos ‘Grand Cru’ 0.6%

listings.rawTitle: Rose de Jamal Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Aromatic Rose - Woody A rose, reimagined—freed from expectation and gently undone. At the heart of this creation lies Moroccan damascena rose absolute, abundant and velvety, revealing a depth that feels almost tactile—lush, softly spiced, and quietly intoxicating. Yet this is no classical portrait. A breath of Moroccan naneh mint—sweet, aromatic, and luminous—moves through the composition like a cool current, lifting the rose into something unexpected, fresh and intriguingly modern. Hints of pink pepper shimmer at the edges, while cedarwood and lavender lend a subtle, grounding elegance. The result is both familiar and entirely new: a rose that feels alive, expansive, and beautifully unbound by tradition. It invites a different way of smelling—where notions of gender dissolve, and only the purity of the scent remains. Named in tribute to Jamal, guardian of these precious Moroccan harvests, the fragrance carries with it a quiet reverence—for craftsmanship, for origin, and for the enduring beauty of the rose, seen here in a new light. Perfumer: Antoine Lie Composition: Rose absolute Morocco ‘Grand Cru’ 5.5% Cedarwood oil Atlas Morocco 2.8% Pink pepper CO2 Madagascar 1.7%

listings.rawTitle: Musc des Sables Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Balsamic – Musky – Oriental A perfume of contrasts, where light meets depth, and sensuality unfolds like a whispered secret. Italian green mandarin opens with a burst of brightness, quickly melting into a heart of exquisite complexity: authentic ambergris, tinctured over six months, pulses with animalic warmth and subtle tobacco-like richness. Orris, Indonesian patchouli, and delicate spices weave through the composition, softened by creamy benzoin and musks, creating a fragrance that is at once diaphanous and enduring. Musc des Sables sits on the skin like a veil of golden dust—sheer yet opulent, spicy yet tender, endlessly evolving. It is an elixir of quiet seduction, where every note feels handcrafted, timeless, and utterly alive. Perfumer: Antoine Lie Composition: Italian Green Mandarin Essence 4.9% French Orris Essence .3% Indonesian Patchouli Essence 1.1% Ambergris Tincture .7%

Fresh – Floral – Powdery Iris Perle is a fragrance of quiet opulence, a symphony of flowers so exquisite it’s hard to know where to begin. At first, a cool silkiness shimmers—elegance distilled into light. Moroccan mimosa absolute radiates honeyed warmth, weaving seamlessly with sultry jasmine and luminous Madagascan ylang-ylang, while violet leaves and Alpine clary sage keep the composition fresh and airy. Beneath it all, French Orris Absolute forms a sensual, creamy foundation—earthy yet ethereal, rich yet restrained—crafted from the finest “grand cru” crops cultivated exclusively for Les Indémodables. Each ingredient tells a story of patience and care: mimosa from hand-selected buds, orris root nurtured for seven years, all coaxed into their most luminous, singing qualities by perfumer Antoine Lie. The result is a perfume that gleams like a pearl—textural, iridescent, and buttery—where every note is alive, radiant, and utterly unforgettable. Iris Perle is not merely worn; it is experienced, a delicate,floral masterpiece that lingers on the skin like memory itself. Perfumer: Antoine Lie Composition: Alpine Clary Sage Moroccan Mimosa Absolute .25% Grand Cru French Orris Absolute .3% Indian Jasmine Absolute .7% Madagascan Ylang Ylang Oil VOP .7%

Ambery - Woody – Leathery A slow, smouldering warmth—like dusk settling over skin. Vanille Havane reveals vanilla in its most profound and unexpected form: not sweet, but shadowed, textured, and deeply alive. Green vanilla intertwines with the richness of Colombian cocoa, softened by supple suede and a glowing amber warmth. The opening carries a whisper of tobacco and embers, a gentle heat that draws you closer. Jasmine unfolds in quiet sensuality, brushed with a trace of caramelised sugar, before deepening into a velvety heart of cocoa and darkened fruits. Each layer feels intimate, evolving slowly, like a secret revealed over time. Here, vanilla is reimagined—not as confection, but as an experience. Facets of rum, spice, and soft leather emerge, creating a composition that feels both indulgent and refined. It lingers close to the skin, warm and magnetic, leaving behind a trail that feels less like perfume and more like memory. Vanille Havane is an invitation—to slow down, to feel, and to lose yourself in the quiet intensity of its embrace. Perfumer: Antoine Lie Composition: Grand Cru Vanilla ‘Mauvais’ Comoros Infusion 9.1% Grand Cru Egyptian Jasmine Egypt concrete ‘Distillat’ .2% Grand Cru Colombian Cocoa Ultrasound Extraction 3.1%

This creation from Atelier Materi lingers like a quiet memory — soft, familiar, and deeply comforting. Tonka Kumaru is a gentle gourmand that wraps the skin in warmth, where creamy almond facets melt into velvety woods and delicate musk."I wanted to reveal the raw beauty of the tonka bean, highlighting its almond notes, gourmand and comforting, which instantly brings me back to the Cléopâtre glue of my childhood - that iconic little pot known to generations by French schoolchildren, and its mischievous temptation to taste it.A true olfactory madeleine, reimagined as a contemporary object of desire." - Véronique Le Bihan"Kumaru" is the name given to the tonka bean in parts of South America — a raw material cherished for its rich, almond-like aroma and natural warmth. Here, it becomes both the heart and the soul of the fragrance, explored in all its depth and subtlety.The perfume opens with a delicate brightness: bergamot and cardamom lift the sweetness of bitter almond, creating a soft, almost nostalgic introduction. In the heart, toasted barley and dry hay evoke a golden, sun-warmed landscape — a quiet nod to nature, a recurring inspiration in Véronique Le Bihan’s vision for the brand, where raw materials are treated with reverence and restraint.As it settles, Tonka Kumaru unfolds slowly. Roasted and slightly milky, it blends seamlessly with smooth vanilla and glowing amber. Musks extend the fragrance into a soft, second-skin finish — intimate, enveloping, and gently addictive.A modern tribute to tonka in its purest expression — understated, sensual, and thoughtfully composed by Céline Bourdoncle Perdriel.

From the very beginning, Chapel Factory has been guided by a singular image: Portrait of a Young Woman (or Lady Wearing a Gauze Headdress, painted by Rogier van der Weyden in 1435.Her spectral whiteness becomes fragrance.Cornette is a fragrance of texture and silence, where airy greenness, soft incense, and refined woods create an impression that feels almost tactile against the skin. Elegant yet introspective, it captures the poetic and architectural spirit that defines Chapel Factory.Another brilliant interpretation and play on contrast by Anaïs Biguine, the perfumer behind the Chapel Factory collection. The inspiration comes from the “winged bonnet” or cornette - the stiffly folded, finely pleated white linen headdress worn by the subject in the painting. This style was typical of married, middle-class women in 15th-century Brussels, carrying a sense of quiet formality and restraint that reflects both social status and modesty of the period.A white, matte, chalk-like incense rises gently like a mineral veil, while a vegetal musk evokes the quiet strength and stillness of her gaze. The composition unfolds with restraint and atmosphere, leaving behind the powerful aura of a monochrome memory - contemplative, sacred, and hauntingly beautiful.The scent profile is built around a luminous “white incense” accord, weaving together violet leaf, styrax, vegetal musk, ambergris, sage, white benzoin, and sandalwood. It captures the spectral whiteness and silent delicacy of the portrait’s subject, forming a mineral veil that lingers like a powerful, monochrome aura.Cornette is an atmosphere suspended in time.

Uplifting, carefreeA celebration of endless summer, Verano captures the warmth, colour and effortless sensuality of Latin America in a fragrance that is both vibrant and deeply comforting.The journey begins with an exhilarating burst of juicy grapefruit and sparkling bergamot, lifted by aromatic juniper, clary sage and the gentle spice of cardamom. As the fragrance unfolds, a graceful bouquet of magnolia, rose and violet is softened by delicate tea notes, bringing elegance and lightness to its heart.The true allure of Verano lies in its captivating dry-down. Creamy cashmeran intertwines with tobacco leaf, soft suede and smooth sandalwood, while moss, tonka and ambergris create a warm, addictive trail that lingers beautifully on the skin. The subtle presence of Iso E Super enhances the composition with an understated radiance, drawing you back time and again.Presented in a striking azure-blue bottle, Verano is a fragrance for those who long for sun-drenched adventures, unforgettable horizons and the quiet luxury of a scent that feels like summer, whatever the season.

Vibrant, earthyFresh, luminous and deeply grounding, Vetiveria is a celebration of nature's quiet strength. Inspired by the verdant landscapes of Indonesia, this elegant composition pays homage to the remarkable vetiver plant, revealing its many facets through a fragrance that feels both invigorating and effortlessly refined.The scent opens with a vibrant burst of Sicilian lime, its sparkling freshness heightened by the aromatic spice of Timur pepper, crisp juniper berry and herbaceous sage. Bright and uplifting, it evokes the feeling of warm sunshine filtering through tropical foliage.As the fragrance settles, a graceful floral heart emerges. Snowbell, lavender, jasmine and orange blossom lend softness and light, creating a delicate contrast to the vibrant citrus opening while adding an air of timeless sophistication.In the dry-down, Vetiveria reveals its true character - earthy vetiver takes centre stage, enriched by verdant moss, resinous rockrose and the creamy warmth of tonka bean. The result is a beautifully balanced fragrance that is fresh yet comforting, vibrant yet quietly confident.Part of the Four Corners of the Earth collection, Vetiveria is an invitation to reconnect with nature - a fragrance that captures the beauty of untamed landscapes and leaves an elegant, unforgettable trail.

Kujira Densetsu, meaning "The Legend of the Whale" in Japanese, is a profound olfactory tribute to one of nature’s most extraordinary phenomena: the whale fall.Inspired by the majestic final descent of a whale into the ocean depths, the fragrance tells a remarkable story of life, death and rebirth. In its quiet sacrifice, the whale becomes a sanctuary, nourishing an entire hidden ecosystem for decades. Through this extraordinary cycle, Senyokô explores themes of resilience, generosity and the profound interconnectedness of life, both above and beneath the sea.Created by perfumer Michael Nordstrand, Kujira Densetsu evokes the mystery and majesty of the ocean, transporting us into deep, mineral-rich waters where light, salt and the vastness of the sea meet.The fragrance opens with an invigorating accord of shiso, Japanese boxwood, Timut pepper and sea fennel, evoking the crisp, mineral freshness of ocean air. At the heart, coleus root, oarweed absolute, mimosa, Labrador tea and sugar kelp conjure submerged forests and mysterious underwater landscapes. The base reveals an evocative blend of patchouli, violet leaves, red algae, sea moss, ambergris and Prachin oud, leaving a deeply marine, woody and contemplative trail.There is something elemental about Kujira Densetsu: the sensation of open water, salty air and the powerful silence of the deep. Yet this is far from a conventional aquatic fragrance. It is darker, more mysterious and deeply immersive, capturing the solemn beauty of the ocean abyss where endings become beginnings and silence gives rise to life.A poetic exploration of the ocean, its mysteries and the extraordinary cycle of life hidden within its depths. A fragrance for those who seek emotion, storytelling and exceptional craftsmanship beyond convention.

A sophisticated ode to specialty coffee, where terroir meets haute parfumerie. Aromatic, Spicy, Oriental Café Arabesque explores coffee from an entirely different perspective, bringing the character and complexity of a remarkable Brazilian specialty coffee into fragrance. Created by perfumer Antoine Lie, the composition is built around an exclusive Brazilian specialty coffee extract, produced through ultrasound extraction to reveal the depth and nuances of the precious ingredient. The result is a fragrance of contrasts: aromatic and woody, fresh yet warm, refined yet deeply sensual. The opening evokes a distinctive ristretto, with vibrant woody and subtly liquorice facets. As the fragrance unfolds, the coffee becomes creamier and more indulgent, revealing a soft mochaccino accord, touched with cocoa powder and lightly roasted hazelnut. The dry down is warm, smooth and enveloping, with precious Laotian benzoin and New Caledonian sandalwood creating a sensual trail that lingers beautifully on the skin. Café Arabesque is a celebration of coffee beyond the cup – its terroir, its richness and its extraordinary aromatic complexity, translated into an elegant and addictive perfume. Perfumer: Antoine Lie Composition: Brazilian Specialty Coffee Ultrasound Extract 'Grand Cru' 6% Laotian Benzoin 'Grand Cru' 0.8% New Caledonian Sandalwood 'Grand Cru' 1.1%

A rose sculpted in light and shadow, not delicate or demure, but lavish, textured and almost architectural.Inspired by the grandeur and mystery of an Italian palazzo, it unfolds like stepping through its luminous façade into darker, velvet-lined rooms: radiant at first, then increasingly sensual, warm and enveloping.The opening is bright and sparkling, where pink grapefruit and bergamot illuminate the rose, touched by the gentle heat of saffron and white pepper. At the heart, rose takes centre stage, joined by iris and geranium to create a velvety, powdery texture with an elegant sensuality.Then the light begins to fade. Oak, patchouli and cedar bring warmth and structure, while leather, immortelle and Vietnamese oud create a darker, richer trail around the rose. The result is a rose transformed, moving between brightness and shadow, softness and strength, timeless elegance and contemporary opulence.What makes Rose Palezia particularly fascinating is the way Atelier Materi works with rose itself. Exceptional Damask rose essences and absolutes from Morocco and Turkey bring depth, warmth and velvety floral richness, while precious Bulgarian rose essence adds a luminous, fresh and almost freshly-cut quality."It all began with an image: a Venetian palazzo salon where a single shaft of light brushed across dark wood panelling, velvet and time-worn gilding, before giving way once more to shadow." For Véronique Le Bihan, the Founder of Atelier Materi, Rose Palezia was imagined not simply as a flower, but as architecture — sculptural, almost monumental, borrowing its opulence from the past while expressing it through a distinctly contemporary language.From Véronique’s vision, perfumer Céline Bourdoncle Perdriel imagined a rose that transcends its floral identity, shaped by spices, woods and leather.The guiding thread was the dialogue between light and shadow — between the delicacy of the rose and the strength of the materials surrounding it. The result is a rose that feels bold, textured, sensual and profound.

Entering a tailor’s atelier and our senses are welcomed by the steam of an iron, the smell of different fabrics. The journey of a couturier begins with this musky fragrance when creating a suit or a dress. The experience moves into feeling the fabrics and this sense, the perfumer has given it by the freshness of the lavender flower and violet leaves, and finished with the roughest but deepest part - cutting, sewing and the sound of the machine piercing thought the fabric.Maître Couturier pays homage to the skillful tailor and their enigmatic world of creating beautiful clothing.The perfumer interpreted the couturier’s atelier into an aromatic, musky and woody fragrance.Looking for the 100ml standard perfume? Click Here.

Shards of reflected light, the glow of raw gold, freshly-cut gemstones, rusty tweezers but still strong to shape delicate jewellery pieces.Slowness, silence. A diamond is set, emotions are contained. The smell of metal, skilled hands shape the rubber to create the moulds, a glimmer of colours - ruby red, antique rose, pearl grey, bright yellow, emerald green. The perfume Maître Joaillier, honours the craft of the jeweller and it is imagined as a woody scent with notes of worked metal, woody and musky notes that round it up to pure luxury.Looking for the 100ml standard perfume? Click Here.

This perfume is a beautiful olfactory interpretation of an imaginary meeting between Paul Vacher (the original brand owner and perfumer of Maison Le Galion) and Rodrigo Flores-Roux, a contemporary perfumer, commissioned by the House of Le Galion to create a few of their latest releases.Rodrigo Flores-Roux was imagining of sharing a cocktail and a cigar in the gardens of Mansion Le Galion on a summer’s afternoon in the shade of blossoming orange trees. He was inspired to create this olfactory portrait by both the thought of this deliciously ideal and carefree moment. Each note is an interpretation of his dream. The perfume is created as an aromatic fougere with a blast of fresh citrusy notes, which are slowly softened by the floral notes. The greenness of the base notes offer wonderful smokiness representing the cigar ash.

Part of the Heritage Collection.Oriental and gourmand fragrance. Immortelle comes from the golden-hued plant everlasting flowers (Immortelle in French) or Helichrysum. Manos' interpretation of this honeyed note is on the sweet and spicy accents, with notes of cinnamon. The result is resinous without being heavy, balanced with sandalwood and benzoin, and the musky depth of the perfume gets better when it dries down and stays poised for hours.Manos describes the scent as Fortune, inspired by the good luck charm that the Everlasting Flower stands for.

Part of the Oriental Collection.An incredibly refined and luxurious oriental perfume.The most exquisite and rare ingredients are impeccably blended to balance the mystery of the East with the contemporary of the West.The perfume is a result of Manos’s inspiration to capture the Quintessence of Life in a single bottle.Manos says “Only a few drops are enough to boost the wearer’s unpretentious self worth”.Looking for the 10ml Travel Eau de Parfum? Click Here.

Part of the Oriental Collection.Sillage Royal is Manos Gerakinis' first fragrance, which he originally created for himself and took nine months to complete. He took extra care to use the most exquisite and quality raw materials for his statement fragrance with a strong personality.Longevity and quality have became key values of the brand. The influence of Manos' hometown, Kavala, is prominent in Sillage Royal, a woody oriental fragrance. The city was part of the Egyptian-Otoman Empire for hundred of years, while being powerful in the production of tobbaco.Looking for the 10ml Travel Eau de Parfum? Click Here.

Part of the Heritage Collection.Rose Poetique is a tribute to Damask Rose. A luxurious floral oriental fragrance whose mystery inspired Ancient Greek poets and claimed it to be the "pride of plants, and queen of flowers" {Sappho}.Manos Gerakinis describes it as Jubilation. A symphony of luxurious blooms blended with a distinctly leathery note, delicate and refined suede feel of saffron. Soft, spicy opening, which gently reveals the beauty of the sensual Damask Rose, taking you to a beguiling and plush journey.The raspberry note gives a delicate and dewy freshness as if the roses were freshly cut. Extraordinary duration, luxurious splendour.

Bellanelle is created in the same timeless and heritage-rich thread as the rest of 1907's Beneath The Surface collection.The perfume is a musky, fruity, floral, serenely feminine composition with a subtly sweet citrus opening; the richness of the fruity notes are enhanced with another classic carnal composition of lily of the valley, jasmine, and ylang ylang, creating a perfume that feels classic whilst remaining modern.

Dame d'Or is a perfume inspired by the Gustav Klimt's painting "Lady In Gold", which resides in New York's "Neue Galerie" for those lucky to visit and admire.The perfume is another sensational aldehydic floral composition, mimicking 1907's Genevieve packed with ylang ylang alongside jasmine in the heart of the perfume and the result is a wonderful trail of creamier and velvety smooth perfume. The aldehyde notes are so beautifully used in Dame d'Or giving that incredible long lasting sparkling sensation with a rich blend of spices, woods and a hint of civette.

Nom is the first fragrance from the brand created with "the gentleman in mind" although we would always suggest it for women to try – a spicy, animalic composition with incredibly powerful amber notes.The clever blend of lavender, nutmeg, patchouli and cinnamon offer an incredible perfume with a lot of depth taking the composition into the animalic ether.We dare you to try it.

Omen is a spicy oriental perfume created by Miguel Matos for Manos Gerakinis. The perfume is inspired by Pythia, the mythical oracle of Delphi. She was the high priestess of the temple of Apollo who delivered her oracles after entering a state of delirium by inhaling the vapours emitted by the sacred chasm beneath the temple.Embracing one of the inscriptions of the temple "Know Thyself", Omen was created to take us to an olfactory journey through powerful spicy oriental notes and enjoyed by those who form their own future.The perfume opens with a fruity burst of apple combined with bay leaf. Followed by leather, amber, oud and ambergris that powerfully envelope the first notes and bringing incredible depth and warmth to the composition. Omen is fresh but possesses deep richness at the same time."Wearing Omen feels like a sunset in autumn." - M. MatosLooking for the 10ml Travel Eau de Parfum? Click Here.

B683 is now available as an extrait. The success of this beautiful scent as an eau de parfum formulation has encouraged Marc-Antoine Barrois and the perfumer Quentin Bisch to create a very intense and sensual extrait strength of B683. Rich, dark and as smooth as velvet, this exceedingly seductive and sexy fragrance is made up to a very powerful 40% concentration for maximum effect and incredible sillage.The original formula has been re-orchestrated with oud to give depth and intensity. Whether in eau de parfum or in extrait strength, B683 is a creation which defines supreme elegance and savoir-faire for the modern generation with timeless feel. This in no mistake is a luxurious and sexy fragrance, which becomes an extension of ones personality: the passionate, well put together gentlemen or the sophisticated, independent and adventurous woman. The spicy top notes include precious saffron, cumin and nutmeg, which entices the senses before taking them into a sensational soft musk, vanilla, amber, aromatic woods and precious oud.A relaxed, harmonised understated style is the perfect way of describing this beautiful creation. A little essential luxury, every day.Interested in the 100ml Eau de Parfum? Click Here.

A dewy iris, accentuated with green notes, incense, vetiver and musk.Finding comfort in the composition of Belle Rives with the iris that shows its floral and powdered nuance under a veil of cedar, vetiver and musk.An accomplished smooth, plush and floral fragrance, which took 2 years to create.

"Années Folles" swings like a mysterious aromatic melody on a warm pulsating amber rhythm.The powdery and woody insouciance wake of a festive atmosphere calls the tune until dawn from the open windows of this proud hotel overlooking the Mediterranean.

You are sipping whisky on a leather couch; time stops, then starts moving backwards.Cabin trunks, club chairs, shagreen powder compacts.Cuir X is the tale whispered in the bar of an opulent luxury hotel in Paris, once patronized by Kings, an Emperor’s mistress and a Catalan genius walking an Ocelot on a leash.The iconic perfumery notes of the 1920s shared by flappers, dandies and adventurers is revived here with this amber and saffron-tinged leather, a dash of tangerine, a touch of jasmine, fine-grained, and decadently powdered with iris, mellowed in the base notes by the burnished tones of vanilla, labdanum and tonka bean.Neither masculine nor feminine, Cuir X is somehow resolutely modern in its androgynous composition – a complex, heady, pulsating perfume that radiates confidence, joy and wild abandonment.

Désarmant resurrects the scent of the mysterious bottle found in a splendid Neo-baroque luxury hotel.Nowadays, creating a lilac scent is a pretty bold move, but of course, everybody loves the spring flower and Philippe Neirnck has given it a starring role in this perfume. Mossy undergrowth, luxurious mauve clusters, vanilla-tinge nectar, and then that heady, animalic, almost leathery whiff that the flowers exhale at the height of their blossom.Désarmant returns lilac to its proper rank and refinement.

No Sport has the cheek of dressing up the queen of flowers as a dandy. Its name slyly refers to a quip by Winston Churchill, who lived in a famous Art Deco hotel in London during the Blitz.? A balcony overlooking Hyde Park: the resinous green of galbanum, the moist earth of patchouli, the brush and roots of vetiver. In window boxes on the terraces, rose bushes are whipped – a time honoured tradition in English schools – by the bracing, minty lemony facets of geranium. As a counterpoint to this typically masculine note, the hay and almond tendrils of Sir Winston’s cigar.An original rose-tobacco accord, as witty as the great man’s bon mots.

listings.rawTitle: Un Air d'Apogée Extrait Extrait de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Un Air d'Apogée ascends in its most powerful form yet - a perfume extrait at 30% concentration. Its iconic leather signature grows deeper and more tactile, unfolding with a near-physical presence on the skin. From within this darkness, an unexpected flash of raspberry breaks through—lush, vibrant, and luminous. Its juicy brightness slices into the leather, igniting a thrilling tension between raw strength and irresistible sweetness. At the heart, iris - the house's emblem - holds the balance. Powdery and refined, it bridges these extremes without taming them, lending an elegant softness that sharpens the contrast rather than dissolving it. On the skin, the leather feels dark and intimate, a raw touch that pulses with life. Free of animal-derived ingredients, it preserves its nobility with uncompromising integrity. Un Air d'Apogée Extrait is a richer, darker, more intense version of the Eau de Parfum creation. A fragrance built on contrast and desire, where leather and raspberry entwine in a deep, magnetic sensuality that lingers long after the moment has passed.

listings.rawTitle: Cierge de Lune Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Cool and limpid as moonlit desert air. Velvety and sensuous as the midnight sky... Like the flower's namesake – the Queen of the Night in Mozart's Magic Flute – Cierge de Lune spans a thrilling range, from crystalline high notes to a deep nocturnal purr. Inspired by the scent of the mysterious night blooming Cereus, Aedes de Venustas' sixth offering unveils the dark side of vanilla.

With its Iris and Incense accord, Iris Nazarena matches the world's most precious aromatic material with the most ancient.Each element of the fragrance formula compliments the next, from the Rose de Mai which adds a touch of floral sensuality, to the Clove and Oud creating a delightful leather base.

A milky light, glowing through wood so polished it turns into silk. A smoldering palette of burnt sienna, lacquered red and molten gold.Abstract yet intensely evocative, Palissandre d’Or expresses the quintessence of Alberto Morillas’ style, defined by the master in three words: “Fluidity, transparency and power".Serene and mystical, Palissandre d’Or is a journey into the quintessence of wood.

In 1935, Albert decided to fulfill a promise made to visit a childhood friend in Egypt. Albert was fascinated with the Ancient Egyptian culture and was overwhelmed to discover all of the essences and scents.Albert extended his visit so he could create a new formula which became part of his exclusive and private perfume collection.

A liquid olfactory poem, dedicated to the totems and spirit guides of the animal kingdom: a beautiful, gender neutral and strikingly unusual composition.See its intricate handmade ceramic cap, from Tuscan artist Alessandro Reggioli, touch its multi coloured wool and silk tail made by Neapolitan 38Verde, and inhale its breath-taking unorthodox perfume - a 'triple whammy' of synesthetic excellence.Notes of Angelica root, Tuscan Neroli, Indian Jasmine float ethereally above Italian Iris and Tonka bean, resting gracefully on a base of New Caledonian Sandalwood, Benzoin and the plush velvety Ambroxan.Mendittorosa are proud to be cruelty free and this release, embodying the majestic beauty of the animal kingdom, presents us with a sensorial moment of mindfulness to remember and respect our fellow animal co-inhabitants, here on planet Earth.

In the depths of the most remote part of our brain, there is a tiny area with the allusive and symbolic shape of an almond called the Amygdala.Inspired by this unusual muse for a Perfume, Amygdala Extrait, at 35% concentration is deliberately powerful, releasing an immense olfactory force, which lifts us above the everyday, as we float in the infinite potential and creativity found deep within the immensity of our own brain.The perfumer let himself be guided by a DTI image of our cerebral hemispheres in which he was able to see an enormous iris flower, where he immediately decided to concentrate and work around a complex and exciting floral bouquet.Jasmine Sambac, Egyptian Violet, Madagascan Ylang Ylang and Tunisian Orange Flower, weave a rich and complex trail – emulating the vortex of colours found deep within our consciousness.Balancing the florality, a pinch of Pink Pepper and Arabica Coffee from South America melds seamlessly into Sri Lankan Cinnamon, above a bed of Guaiac Wood, earthy Vetiver and warm resinous Labdanum.The result is a synesthetic journey of colour, scent and emotions – where nothing is quite what it seems, an unfolding olfactory journey of multi faceted intrigue.

listings.rawTitle: Hora de la Verdad Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Translated as 'The Hour of Truth', Hora de la Verdad - this uncompromising composition is inspired by the novel 'Death in the Afternoon' by Ernest Hemingway.This continues the arc of Senyoko's perfumery - where the muses are art, music and literature.An impressionistic olfactory painting of the Bullfight, of blood, sweat, adrenaline, dust, leather and toil.The initial blast of orange and bergamot with coriander reflect the brightness of the midday sun, whilst the combination of contrasting peppers indicate sweat and tension.Saffron mimics the dust and arid earth of the arena, but most prominent is the rose and geranium, which in this case, has a sharp, almost metallic edge - indicating the blood of the Matador, or that of the bull.The Vetiver, Leather, Ambergris, Musk and Labdanum add a deep primal animalic thrust to the base of this unorthodox and bold perfume - giving an underlying warmth and depth to the sharper aspects of the top and middle notes.This is a bold, bestial and brilliant perfume.Interested in the Hora de la Verdad (Sombra) 50ml Perfume? Click Here.

A unisex and vintage ode to all things 1920's - jazz, pearls, flappers, joie de vivre, imma dressed gentlemen, cigars and racy cars. An understated but glamorous, assured perfume.A balanced composition of fresh and warm - first comes the blast of Sicilian Bergamot and Lemon - emulating the shimmering glint of jewellery. Pink pepper, Orange Blossom, Osmanthus give us a tantalising and juicy heart before the sensual warmth of Tonka, Leather and Vetiver linger on, creating a plush bed of velvety nuances that caress the skin, suggestive but never overtly sexual.An upbeat and joyful scent to be worn whenever the mood seizes you.

A crisp, green, unexpected cologne for cooler weather.An olfactive contradiction - a sharp opening with a soft afterglow – a caress alternating between the ferocity of rosebush thorns and the smoothness of balmy ambers.A resinous, earthy and meditative perfume.

A pure and meditative scent, a mirage of profound silence, of rare and refined ingredients harvested from stillness."Abime" translates as Oblivion, but Violet perceived it as a place of calm, a state of mind: shadows become comforting, the unfathomable darkness becomes equilibrium.Let go, surrender, fall freely into the scented abyss.With notes of pepper and incense swirl above smooth distinctive palo santo wood, swimming in an olfactory midnight ocean of ink, sandalwood and the noblest of cedarwood. Finally reaching Elysium, a nirvana like slumber on a rich resinous bed of labdanum.Existential Olfactive Bliss.

Part of the La Pleiade collectionLiterary Inspiration: Charles Perrault 1628 – 1703How to express an old French Fairy-tale as liquid poetry? Only in the hands of a master Perfumer such as Anais Biguine.Here she deftly creates a surreal and alchemic perfume, sepia toned and deeply evocative of the passage of time, covered in dust and faded mystery.Underneath the scent of a suave animal skin, a magical and supernatural phosphorescent heart glows.Charles Perrault wrote of an adults moral fairy-tale of virtue ultimately victorious over suffering, and here reinterpreted not in words, but as notes, harmonies and accords of the highest cerebral niche Perfumery.

Leather Case EditionTheatrical, dense and heady."MARLOWE" is a fragrance inspired by Christopher Marlowe, who was the bad boy of Elizabethan theatre. Handsome and good natured, Marlowe was also a spy and a student of the occult.The top notes feature the poisonous nectar of the tuberose blended with opulent osmanthus. The middle notes are dried flowers, evoking tragic poetry and hints of powdery leather make up the base notes.

listings.rawTitle: Hora de la Verdad Sombra Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Chiaroscuro, in art, is the use of strong contrasts between light and dark, usually bold contrasts affecting a whole composition.In its latest creation, Senyoko is showcasing juxtaposition between the metallic blood accord and the deeply animalic leather notes that pulsate from the base of the perfume Hora de La Verdad Sombra.Inspired by the curious relationship between the Bull and the Bullfighter, the mutual respect, adrenaline, blood, sweat, victory and death – that holds the keys to the olfactory vision of this distinct and unorthodox perfume.Interested in the Hora de la Verdad (Sol) 50ml Perfume? Click Here.
